device_name: XIA 3 SPINAL SYSTEM, UNIPLANNER/REDUCTION SCREWS & VITALLIUM ROD
device_name_fda: XIA 3 SPINAL SYSTEM, UNIPLANNER/REDUCTION SCREWS & VITALLIUM ROD
what_it_is:
The Xia 3 is a pedicle screw system for use in the thoracolumbar spine and intended to treat degenerative, trauma, deformity and adult idiopathic scoliosis (AIS). It is centered around the Xia 3 screw which can accommodate 5.5 and 6.0mm rods. The self tapping screw has a polyaxial head with 50 degrees of conical angulation.

Features:
- Titanium alloy screws
- 50 degrees conical angulation
- Favored angle screws available
- 6 pointed star screwdriver pattern
- Full set of hook options, rod connectors, side connectors, etc
- Screw options:
- Monoaxial screw - for deformity correction
- Size options: 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0, 6.5, 7.0, 7.5mm
- Length options: 20-90mm
- Uniplanar screw: good for one plane angulation for deformity correction. Also available with reduction thread
- Screw diameters: 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0, 6.5, 7.0, 7.5mm
- Length options: 20-60mm
- Polyaxial screw - standard corticocancellous screw 50 degrees conical angulation.
- Diameter options: 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0, 6.5, 7.0, 7.5mm
- Length options: 20-90mm
- Biased angle: available in medial and cranial-caudal angle
- Diameter options: 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8.5, 9.5mm
- Length options: 20-100mm
- Closed head polyaxial - good for sacro-iliac fusion
- Diameter options: 6.5, 7.5, 8.5, 9.5mm
- Length options: 30-100mm
